svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The seven-step pipeline, from 19,296 genes to 40 literature-checked predictions
svg.desc: Input: 19,296 human protein-coding genes, DepMap 26Q3 CRISPR screens and GO annotations. Step 1 pre-registers 4,924 uncharacterised genes (4,271 scorable). Step 2 scores co-essentiality with the zavg_BEF tool. Step 3 keeps genes whose partner list reproduces and that are expressed: 646 pass, at least about 322 with real signal. Step 4 assigns a GO term to 4,137 genes. Step 5 calibrates on a 2018 hold-out: 3.0 percent right against 0.5 percent for a matched null; highest p_cal 0.141. Step 6 ranks 245 eligible genes by p_cal into a top 40. Step 7: blinded judges supported 18 of 40 predictions against 3 of 120 decoys. Output: one GO term, p_cal and labels per gene.

g.text: INPUT
19,296 human protein-coding genes; GO annotations (current and 2018)
DepMap 26Q3 CRISPR knockout screens: 1,361 cancer cell lines

g.title: Step 1: pre-register uncharacterised genes
g.text: Pre-register uncharacterised genes
No experimental GO function and little literature; frozen by hash
19,296 → 4,924 genes (4,271 scorable in DepMap)

g.title: Step 2: score co-essentiality with the published tool
g.text: Score co-essentiality
Published tool zavg_BEF, read-only: a score for every gene pair
4,271 genes scored; tool benchmark reproduced (AP 0.3451)

g.title: Step 3: decide whether the gene has usable signal
g.text: Decide if the gene has usable signal
Top-25 partners reproduce in split halves; gene is expressed
646 pass (13%); at least ~322 with real signal

g.title: Step 4: assign a candidate function
g.text: Assign a candidate function
GO term with the highest summed partner score, ≥ 2 partners
4,137 genes get a top GO term

g.title: Step 5: calibrate confidence on a temporal hold-out
g.text: Calibrate confidence on the future
Model fitted on 809 genes annotated after 2018 → p_cal
Hold-out: 3.0% right vs 0.5% null; max p_cal 0.141

g.title: Step 6: add orthogonal evidence and prioritise
g.text: Add orthogonal evidence and prioritise
Rank by p_cal; independent data and checks shown as labels
245 eligible genes → top 40 (no gene reached a tier)

g.title: Step 7: check the literature blind
g.text: Check the literature blind
Two judges, redacted evidence, three decoy statements per gene
18/40 predictions supported vs 3/120 decoys
OUTPUT
For each gene: one GO term, p_cal and warning labels.
About 4.9 top terms expected to be confirmed (30.5 if every
gene were later annotated); most top-40 functions already published.

svg.text: Steps 3–6 label every scorable gene; only expressed, assessable genes
with a p_cal can enter the top 40.
